topic: The Fractal Logic of Towers: From Ternary Systems to Sierpinski Triangles
target_audience: University students in Computer Science or Mathematics

sections.title: The Ternary Foundation
lecture_lines: Ternary counting represents states of Towers of Hanoi.
Each digit corresponds to one of three pegs.
Movement sequences are defined by ternary transitions.
animations: Display 3^n grid of squares to represent ternary states. Color: #FFFFFF. Integrate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tower.svg] to represent the base structure.
Animate transition of grid into a nested triangle. Color: #FFD700. Position nested triangle centrally in Row B to preserve horizontal flow.

Explicitly label base case n=1 with circular indicator in Row E, Col 4. Color: #00FF00. Incorporate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tower.svg] to denote the finalized base configuration.

sections.title: Constrained Towers of Hanoi
lecture_lines: Constraint limits movement to adjacent pegs only.
Disks hop between A, B, and C.
This structure forms a cyclic ternary path.
animations: Display [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tower.svg] with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disc.svg] on [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/peg.svg] A, in Row B. Color: #FF4500.
Iterate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disc.svg] moves through pegs A-B-C sequentially. Color: #1E90FF. Position sequence path in Row D for readability.
Display flashing red 'X' over restricted non-adjacent move near [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/peg.svg] in Row B, Col 5. Color: #FF0000.

sections.title: The Sierpinski Connection
lecture_lines: Map constrained state-space to a geometric graph.
Recursive connections build a Sierpinski Triangle.
Higher disk counts increase fractal depth.
animations: Render initial triangle centrally in Row B using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disk.svg]. Color: #FFD700.
Animate recursive subdivision of triangle step 1 to 2 in Row E. Color: #FFFFFF. Map theta variables to arcs explicitly.
Animate removal of center triangle using fade-out. Color: #FF4500. Maintain triangle in Rows B-E, Col 4-6.

sections.title: Unified Traversal Logic
lecture_lines: Optimal solutions follow the triangle's perimeter.
Path-finding logic mirrors the fractal structure.
Every move maps to a geometric step.
animations: Render state graph nodes centrally in Row D using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/triangle.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate perimeter path traversal connecting nodes sequentially. Color: #1E90FF. Map vertex coefficients explicitly.
Place terminal green target icon at final node in Row E, Col 5. Color: #00FF00. Balance with graph structure in Row D.
